proposed_capability: P83 independently verify and repair merged async interoperability/install claims: prevent uninstall from deleting clean-looking local unpublished Git commits, branches, refs, reflog work, or config changes; establish one user-scoped canonical desktop lock across Git worktrees and clones, with safe path checks and bounded cleanup; regression coverage. Inherited #86/#88 were green but proof limited to supplied test scenarios. Also enforce 15,000ms as a minimum (not just a default) so legacy idle-ms overrides cannot silently seize the screen after 1 second.
player_save_control_impact: No game input changes or save access. Safer removal: only proven installer-created clone with exact initial Git identity/refs/reflog/config, no changes or unique work; legacy manifests preserve clone. A user-profile resolved shared lock prevents separate worktree actors from simultaneously claiming one desktop while player still wins by 15-second OS idle probe. No key hooks/cron/telemetry.
expected_outcome: Uninstall preserves clean local commits/branches and legacy installs; a freshly cloned pristine install can still be fully uninstalled; cross-checkout owner locks resolve to same profile. Existing host and Playwright callers reuse control_handoff only, no second arbiter. Callers cannot shorten operator inactivity grace below 15 seconds.
negative_tests: Clean Git worktree with unpushed HEAD commit is preserved on uninstall
Local branch with unique work is preserved when HEAD/main appears clean
Stash or changed Git config/ref/reflog prevents automatic clone deletion
Legacy manifest without clone provenance removes only launcher and preserves checkout
Fresh clean installer-created clone removes correctly
Two different repository/worktree locations resolve same canonical desktop lock, reject concurrent lock
Symlink or unsafe lock root fails closed
Lock files released normally; clean empty runtime lock directory cleanup is bounded
Unknown player presence never authorizes computer input
Any --idle-ms or API override below 15,000ms raises IDLE_THRESHOLD_OUT_OF_RANGE before focus/action
rollback_path: Revert PR; install and use path retain prior behavior. Uninstall safe cleanup remains in installed bootstrapper only after operator explicitly clicks or invokes uninstall; rollback must never delete unique work.
unresolved_unknowns: Actual host paths, Windows desktop mutex behavior and local worktree concurrency require real host P08 observation
Other agents not yet adopting shared lock remain outside enforceable coverage; separate screen-atlas PR #90 is independently owned
